name: Audacity
summary: Free, open source, cross-platform audio software for multi-track recording and editing.
description: Audacity is an easy-to-use, multi-track audio editor and recorder for Windows, macOS, GNU/Linux and other operating systems. It supports high quality 32-bit float audio, real-time effects preview, spectral selection, and noise removal filters.

capabilities.detail: Record live audio through a microphone or mixer.
Cut, copy, splice and mix sounds together.
Spectrogram view modes for visualizing and selecting frequencies.
Eliminate background hiss, hum, and buzz from audio tracks.
Export recordings in WAV, AIFF, MP3, AU, FLAC and Ogg Vorbis formats.

name: VLC media player
summary: Free and open-source cross-platform multimedia player and streaming engine.
description: VLC is a free and open source cross-platform multimedia player and framework that plays most multimedia files as well as DVDs, Audio CDs, VCDs, and various streaming protocols. Plays everything - Files, Discs, Webcams, Devices and Streams.

capabilities.detail: Plays all formats without codec packs needed: MPEG-2, MPEG-4, H.264, MKV, WebM, WMV, MP3.
Stream video and audio over HTTP, RTP, RTSP, MMS protocols.
Load and synchronize external subtitles in SRT, ASS, and SSA formats.
10-band audio graphic equalizer, spatializer, and volume normalizer.
Transcode media files between various container formats and codecs.

name: OBS Studio
summary: Free and open source software for video recording and live streaming.
description: OBS (Open Broadcaster Software) Studio is free and open source software for video recording and live streaming. Stream to Twitch, YouTube and many other providers or record your own videos with high quality H264/AAC encoding.

capabilities.detail: Broadcast live video streams to Twitch, YouTube, Kick, and custom RTMP destinations.
Real-time high performance video and audio capturing from monitors, windows, or capture cards.
Create scenes made up of multiple sources including window captures, images, text, and browser windows.
Intuitive audio mixer with per-source filters such as noise gate, noise suppression, and gain.
Hardware-accelerated encoding using NVIDIA NVENC, AMD AMF, and Intel QuickSync.

name: GIMP
summary: GNU Image Manipulation Program for photo retouching, image composition and authoring.
description: GIMP is a cross-platform image editor available for GNU/Linux, macOS, Windows and more operating systems. Whether you are a graphic designer, photographer, illustrator, or scientist, GIMP provides you with sophisticated tools to get your job done.

capabilities.detail: Advanced retouching techniques including clone, healing, and perspective clone tools.
Full suite of painting tools including brush, pencil, airbrush, and blend tools.
Full layer, channel, and mask support with blend modes and opacity control.
Curves, levels, color balance, hue-saturation, and high-bit-depth color precision up to 32-bit float.
Integration with Darktable and RawTherapee for importing RAW digital camera files.

name: BleachBit
summary: Free disk space cleaner, privacy manager, and system optimizer.
description: BleachBit quickly frees disk space and tirelessly guards your privacy. Cleans cache, deletes cookies, clears Internet history, shreds temporary files, deletes logs, and discards junk you didn't know was there. Designed for Linux and Windows systems.

capabilities.detail: Frees up gigabytes of disk space by removing caches, logs, crash dumps, and temp files.
Securely shreds files to prevent recovery and hide their contents.
Cleans caches and cookies from Firefox, Chrome, Edge, Safari, and dozens of applications.
Overwrites free disk space to hide previously deleted files and data remnants.
Clears MRU lists, recent document history, bash history, and search histories.

name: Kopia
summary: Fast and secure open-source backup tool with client-side encryption and deduplication.
description: Kopia is a simple, fast and secure open-source backup tool for Windows, macOS and Linux with fast client-side deduplication, compression, and end-to-end encryption. Works with cloud providers (S3, B2, Azure, GCS) or local disks.

capabilities.detail: Creates point-in-time snapshot backups of directories and file systems.
Encrypts all snapshot blocks before leaving machine using AES-256 or ChaCha20.
Deduplicates file chunks across snapshots so unchanged files consume zero extra storage.
Supports AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, Backblaze B2, Azure Blob, WebDAV, SFTP, and local disks.
Automated snapshot scheduling with configurable retention policies.

name: Czkawka
summary: Multi-functional, fast duplicate file finder and disk space cleaner.
description: Czkawka is a simple, fast and free app written in Rust to remove unnecessary files from your computer: duplicate files, empty folders, big files, empty files, temporary files, similar images, similar videos, same music, invalid symlinks, and broken files.

capabilities.detail: Finds duplicates based on file size, hash (Blake3, SHA256), and byte-by-byte comparison.
Detects images that are visually similar even if resized or compressed using perceptual hashing.
Detects duplicate music tracks and audio files based on acoustic fingerprints and audio tags.
Recursively scans and removes empty directories.
Finds invalid and broken symbolic links across file systems.

name: Immich
summary: High-performance self-hosted photo and video backup and management solution.
description: Immich is a high-performance self-hosted photo and video management solution designed for seamless backup directly from phones and desktops. Features fast web interfaces, ML-powered face recognition, clip search, maps, and shared albums.

capabilities.detail: Organize thousands of photos with albums, favorites, archive, and smart timelines.
On-device machine learning facial clustering and named person libraries.
Search photos using natural language concepts like 'sunset on the beach' using CLIP models.
Interactive map view showing where photos were taken with city and landmark resolution.
Share photo collections with family and automatically sync partner libraries.

name: Kodi
summary: Open source home theater software and entertainment hub for digital media.
description: Kodi is an award-winning free and open source home theater / media center software and entertainment hub for digital media. It brings your television, movies, music, and pictures together into a customizable 10-foot interface.

capabilities.detail: Scrapes posters, fanart, actors, and plot descriptions for movies and TV series.
Organizes music collection with cue sheets, tag reading, and smart playlists.
Watch and record live television with electronic program guide (EPG) support.
Control through CEC TV remotes, web browsers, and mobile companion apps.
Vast library of user-created addons for streaming services, skins, and metadata scrapers.

name: 7-Zip
summary: High compression ratio open source file archiver with multi-format support.
description: 7-Zip is a free and open-source file archiver with a high compression ratio in 7z format with LZMA and LZMA2 compression. It supports packing/unpacking 7z, XZ, BZIP2, GZIP, TAR, ZIP and WIM formats, plus unpacking RAR, CAB, ISO, and MSI.

capabilities.detail: Ultra high compression ratio with LZMA and LZMA2 algorithms.
Extracts 7z, ZIP, RAR, TAR, GZ, ISO, CAB, DMG, VHD, and RPM archives.
Strong AES-256 encryption in 7z and ZIP formats with filename encryption support.
Splits huge archives into manageable pieces for storage or transfer.
Seamless integration with Windows Explorer context menu and command line interface.

name: Blender
summary: Free and open source 3D creation suite supporting modeling, rigging, animation, and rendering.
description: Blender is the free and open source 3D creation suite. It supports the entirety of the 3D pipeline—modeling, rigging, animation, simulation, rendering, compositing and motion tracking, video editing and 2D animation pipeline.

capabilities.detail: Extensive modeling toolset including polygon meshes, curves, surfaces, and sculpting.
Cycles ray-tracing engine with GPU acceleration via OptiX, CUDA, HIP, and Metal.
Rigging, skeletal deformation, forward/inverse kinematics, and non-linear animation editor.
Fluid, smoke, fire, cloth, dynamic paint, and rigid body simulation tools.
Node-based compositor for post-processing and motion tracking.

name: Inkscape
summary: Professional quality vector graphics software for SVG illustration, icons, and diagrams.
description: Inkscape is a professional vector graphics editor for Linux, Windows and macOS. It's free and open source, with powerful tools for drawing, shape creation, typography, Bezier curves, and full SVG specification support.

capabilities.detail: Object creation using pencil, pen (Bezier curves), calligraphy tool, and shapes.
Native SVG file format compliance with live XML editor.
Precision path manipulating, node alignment, boolean operations, and path insetting/outsetting.
Multi-line text, kerning, letter spacing, text on path, and SVG font editing.

name: Kdenlive
summary: Powerful multi-track non-linear video editor for Linux, Windows, and macOS.
description: Kdenlive is an acronym for KDE Non-Linear Video Editor. It provides multi-track video editing, audio mixing, color correction, titling, and support for almost all audio and video formats through FFmpeg.

capabilities.detail: Unlimited video and audio tracks with timeline sequencing and ripple editing.
RGB Parade, Vectorscope, Waveform monitors, and LUT color grading.
Real-time audio monitoring, audio effects, and keyframable volume control.
Speech-to-text subtitling powered by OpenAI Whisper.

name: HandBrake
summary: Open-source video transcoder for converting video from nearly any format to modern codecs.
description: HandBrake is a tool for converting video from nearly any format to a selection of modern, widely supported codecs. Convert videos for iPhone, iPad, Android, Apple TV, Chromecast, or web playback with fine-tuned video filters and compression controls.

capabilities.detail: Converts MKV, MP4, WebM, AVI, and DVD/Blu-ray into AV1, H.265, H.264, VP9.
Intel Quick Sync, NVIDIA NVENC, AMD VCN, and Apple VideoToolbox hardware encoders.
Queue multiple encode jobs with preset video dimensions and audio passthrough.
Denoise, deinterlace, detelecine, deblock, and decomb filters.

name: Shotcut
summary: Free, open source, cross-platform non-linear video editor with wide format support.
description: Shotcut is a free, open source, cross-platform video editor supporting hundreds of audio and video formats and codecs thanks to FFmpeg. Features 4K resolution support, native timeline editing with no import required, and GPU effects.

capabilities.detail: Native timeline editing without project import conversion overhead.
Handles 4K ProRes, DNxHD, and RAW footage at 60fps.
Keyframable size, position, rotate, blur, color grading, and chroma key filters.

name: Darktable
summary: Open source photography workflow application and non-destructive RAW developer.
description: Darktable is an open source photography workflow application and raw developer. A virtual lighttable and darkroom for photographers. It manages your digital negatives in a database and lets you view them through a zoomable lighttable and develop raw images.

capabilities.detail: Never modifies original camera raw files; all adjustments are stored in sidecar XMP files.
Direct camera control and instant image capture to workstation over USB.
Modern linear RGB pipeline with filmic tone equalizer and color calibration.
Tagging, rating, geolocation map view, and metadata search for camera collections.

name: RawTherapee
summary: Non-destructive RAW photo editor with advanced demosaicing and color grading.
description: RawTherapee is a powerful, cross-platform raw photo processing program, released as Free Software (GPLv3). It is designed for developing raw files from a broad range of digital cameras and is targeted at users wishing to develop high-quality images.

capabilities.detail: Dual-demosaicing algorithms combining AMaZE, RCD, and DCB for noise-free sharpness.
Multi-scale wavelet noise reduction and edge-preserving texture enhancement.
Advanced perceptual color appearance modeling for true-to-life tones.

name: Krita
summary: Professional free and open source digital painting studio and 2D animation app.
description: Krita is a professional FREE and open source painting program made by artists that want to see affordable art tools for everyone. Concept art, illustrations, comics, matte paintings, textures and 2D animations.

capabilities.detail: Over 100 professionally crafted brush engines with brush stabilizer and wrap-around seamless mode.
Traditional timeline animation with onion skinning, audio playback, and MP4/GIF export.
Vector shapes, text tools, and speech bubble paths for comics and concept art.

name: Ardour
summary: Professional digital audio workstation (DAW) for recording, editing, and mixing sound.
description: Ardour is an open source, collaborative audio workstation for Linux, macOS and Windows. Record, edit and mix multi-track audio and MIDI. Produce CDs, mix video soundtracks, or just experiment with new music ideas.

capabilities.detail: Full professional mixing console with unlimited tracks, busses, and sends.
Piano roll MIDI editor, step sequencing, and hardware synth control.
Supports VST, VST3, AU, and LV2 audio effect and instrument plugins.
Synchronized video window with frame-accurate audio scrubbing and soundtrack export.

name: LMMS
summary: Free, open source cross-platform digital audio workstation and beat synthesizer.
description: LMMS is a sound generation system, synthesizer, beat/baseline producer and MIDI control system which powers an entire home studio. Everything from song composition to mixing and mastering can be done inside LMMS.

capabilities.detail: Pattern-based drum machine and bassline grid for electronic music.
Built-in triple oscillator, Monstro synthesizer, and SoundFont player.
Fine-tuned MIDI note entry, chords, velocity, and panning automation.

name: MuseScore
summary: Professional sheet music engraving and music notation software.
description: MuseScore is an open source music notation program that runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Create, playback and print beautiful sheet music. Features Muse Sounds realistic orchestra samples, guitar tablature, and MIDI playback.

capabilities.detail: Engrave notes, dynamic markings, articulations, and lyrics onto standard musical staves.
Realistic instrument playback using Muse Sounds sample libraries.
Interchange scores between notation software via MusicXML and MIDI.

name: Strawberry Music Player
summary: Music player and collection organizer aimed at audiophiles with high resolution audio.
description: Strawberry is a music player and music collection organizer. It is aimed at music collectors and audiophiles. With Strawberry you can play your audio files, listen to audio CDs and stream internet radio while managing bit-perfect audio output.

capabilities.detail: Direct ALSA and WASAPI bit-perfect audio stream transmission without resampling.
Smart playlists, audio tag editing, album cover art scrapers, and lyrics display.
Plays DSD, WAV, FLAC, WavPack, Ogg Vorbis, Speex, MPC, TrueAudio, AIFF, MP4, MP3.

name: mpv
summary: Free, open-source, and cross-platform command-line and embeddable media player.
description: mpv is a free (as in freedom) media player for the command line. It supports a wide variety of media file formats, audio and video codecs, and subtitle types. Known for high quality video output with color management, interpolation, and Lua scripting.

capabilities.detail: High-grade video scaling algorithms, color management, HDR tone mapping, and interpolation.
Zero-bloat user interface with extensive Lua scripting and JSON IPC controls.

name: FreeCAD
summary: General-purpose parametric 3D CAD modeler and BIM design tool.
description: FreeCAD is a general-purpose parametric 3D computer-aided design (CAD) modeler and a building information modeling (BIM) software application with finite element-method (FEM) support. Export to STEP, IGES, STL, SVG, DXF, OBJ, and IFC formats.

capabilities.detail: Modify designs easily by going back into history and changing parameters.
Generate 2D views and dimensioned schematics from 3D models with TechDraw.
Stress and thermal FEA simulations directly inside CAD models.

name: LibreOffice
summary: Full-featured open-source office suite for documents, spreadsheets, and presentations.
description: LibreOffice is a powerful and free office suite, used by millions of people around the world. Its clean interface and feature-rich tools help you unleash your creativity and enhance your productivity: Writer (word processor), Calc (spreadsheets), Impress (presentations), Draw (vector diagrams).

capabilities.detail: Full rich text formatting, styles, table of contents, and PDF export via Writer.
Advanced statistical formulas, pivot tables, charts, and solver analysis via Calc.
Slide transitions, animations, presenter console, and multimedia slides via Impress.
Open, edit, and save Microsoft Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), and PowerPoint (.pptx).

name: Mozilla Thunderbird
summary: Free and open-source email, calendar, and contacts client from Mozilla.
description: Thunderbird is a free email application that's easy to set up and customize. Features tabbed email, unified folders, address book, integrated calendar, chat support, and multiple account management with privacy protection.

capabilities.detail: IMAP/POP3 account synchronization with message tagging, filters, and fast search.
Local and CalDAV calendar scheduling with reminders and event invites.
End-to-end email encryption and digital signatures using OpenPGP.

name: KeePassXC
summary: Cross-platform offline password manager with military-grade encryption.
description: KeePassXC is a community fork of KeePassX, the cross-platform port of KeePass for Windows. KeePassXC can store your passwords safely and auto-type them into your everyday websites and applications without relying on cloud servers.

capabilities.detail: Encrypts complete password database with AES-256, ChaCha20, and Argon2 key derivation.
Direct keyboard autotype into applications and secure browser extension integration.
Generates RFC 6238 TOTP two-factor authentication codes natively inside the vault.

name: Bitwarden Desktop
summary: Open-source password manager for syncing encrypted credentials across devices.
description: Bitwarden is an integrated open-source password management solution for individuals, teams, and business organizations. Store logins, secure notes, credit cards, and identities protected by zero-knowledge end-to-end encryption.

capabilities.detail: Data is encrypted and decrypted on the client device using AES-CBC 256-bit encryption.
Synchronize passwords across desktop, mobile, and web browsers with self-hosting support.

name: Syncthing
summary: Continuous peer-to-peer decentralized file synchronization without central cloud servers.
description: Syncthing is a continuous file synchronization program. It synchronizes files between two or more computers in real time, safely protected from prying eyes. Your data is your data alone and you deserve to choose where it is stored.

capabilities.detail: Synchronizes folders directly between devices across LAN or internet using Block Exchange Protocol.
Communication secured using TLS with cryptographic device certificates.
Preserves file versions (simple, trash can, staggered) to protect against accidental deletes.

name: Restic
summary: Fast, secure, verifiable backup program using client-side cryptography and deduplication.
description: Restic is a backup program that does backups right. Its design principles are: easy, fast, verifiable, secure, and efficient. Encrypts data with AES-256 in CTR mode and authenticates using Poly1305-AES.

capabilities.detail: Snapshots are tamper-proof and cryptographically verified against silent bit rot.
Back up directly to SFTP, REST server, AWS S3, Google Cloud, Azure, and Backblaze B2.

name: Duplicati
summary: Free backup software to store encrypted backups on cloud storage providers.
description: Duplicati is a free backup client that securely stores encrypted, incremental, compressed backups on cloud storage services and remote file servers. Works with Amazon S3, OneDrive, Google Drive, Rackspace, and WebDAV.

capabilities.detail: Automated background scheduled backups to any cloud storage backend with web UI.
All backup volumes are encrypted locally before transmission using standard AES-256.

name: BorgBackup
summary: Deduplicating backup program with authenticated encryption and SSH transport.
description: BorgBackup (short: Borg) is a deduplicating backup program. Optionally, it supports compression and authenticated encryption. The main goal of Borg is to provide an efficient and secure way to back up data.

capabilities.detail: Content-defined chunking deduplicates files even when offset by small edits.
All data protected with 256-bit AES or ChaCha20-Poly1305.

name: FileZilla
summary: Fast and reliable cross-platform FTP, FTPS and SFTP client with tabbed UI.
description: FileZilla Client is a free, open source FTP client. It supports FTP, SFTP, and FTPS (FTP over SSL/TLS). Features site manager, bookmarks, drag and drop, directory comparison, and remote file editing.

capabilities.detail: Transfers files over SSH File Transfer Protocol (SFTP) and secure FTPS.
Synchronized browsing and directory comparison between local and remote hosts.

name: Transmission
summary: Fast, lightweight, and easy BitTorrent client with minimal resource consumption.
description: Transmission is a fast, easy, and free BitTorrent client. It has an extremely small resource footprint, native UI across platforms, encryption support, magnet link resolution, and web interface controls.

capabilities.detail: Downloads torrents and magnet links with peer exchange (PEX) and DHT.
Set speed limits and scheduled speed caps for seeding and downloading.

name: qBittorrent
summary: Feature-rich open source BitTorrent client with integrated search and IP filtering.
description: The qBittorrent project aims to provide an open-source software alternative to µTorrent. It offers an integrated torrent search engine, sequential downloading, web user interface, IP filtering, and torrent creation.

capabilities.detail: Search multiple torrent sites simultaneously within the client.
Download video files sequentially to preview media while downloading.

name: Jellyfin
summary: Free software media system for managing and streaming movies, TV shows, and music.
description: Jellyfin is the volunteer-built media solution that puts you in control of your media. Stream to any device from your own server, with no strings attached, no premium licenses or tracking.

capabilities.detail: Hardware-transcodes and streams personal movies, music, and photos to client devices.
Fetches posters, overviews, and downloads subtitles automatically.

name: Calibre
summary: Powerful and easy to use open-source e-book manager, viewer, and format converter.
description: calibre is a powerful and easy to use e-book manager. It allows you to do nearly everything and it takes things steps beyond normal e-book software. Features library management, format conversion (EPUB, MOBI, PDF), e-reader syncing, and web server.

capabilities.detail: Catalog e-books by author, title, publisher, tags, and rating with metadata editor.
Converts between EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, PDF, TXT, and RTF formats.
Syncs books seamlessly to Kindle, Kobo, and Android e-readers.

name: Logseq
summary: Privacy-first, open-source knowledge base and outliner working on local Markdown files.
description: Logseq is a joyful, privacy-first, open-source knowledge base. A connected notebook for thinking, learning, and collaborating. Works on top of local plain-text Markdown and Org-mode files.

capabilities.detail: Link thoughts with [[brackets]] and inspect connected concept graphs.
Chronological bullet journaling with block references and task queries.
All files live as plain text on your hard drive with no vendor lock-in.

name: Joplin
summary: Secure note taking and to-do application with end-to-end encryption and markdown support.
description: Joplin is an open source note-taking and to-do application. Can handle a large number of notes organized into notebooks. Notes are searchable, can be tagged and modified, and can synchronize across devices via Nextcloud, Dropbox, OneDrive, or WebDAV.

capabilities.detail: WYSIWYG and split-screen Markdown editor with math formulae (KaTeX) and chemical equations.
E2EE ensures no cloud provider can read note text or attachments.

name: VSCodium
summary: Community-driven, telemetry-free binary distribution of Microsoft VS Code editor.
description: VSCodium is a community-driven, freely-licensed binary distribution of Microsoft’s editor VS Code. Features identical code editing, debugging, Git integration, and extension marketplace support without Microsoft tracking and telemetry.

capabilities.detail: IntelliSense syntax completion, parameter hints, and refactoring for 100+ languages.
Breakpoints, call stack inspection, and interactive console debugging.
Built from vscode source with telemetry, data tracking, and proprietary binaries disabled.

name: Neovim
summary: Vim-fork focused on extensibility, Lua configuration, and built-in Language Server Protocol.
description: Neovim is a hyperextensible Vim-based text editor. Features built-in LSP client, Treesitter syntax parsing, modern terminal UI, Lua first-class scripting, and asynchronous plugin architecture.

capabilities.detail: Fast keyboard-driven modal editing with vim motions and macros.
Native LSP client for auto-completion, diagnostics, and go-to-definition.
Fast LuaJIT scripting engine powering thousands of plugins.

name: Alacritty
summary: Fast, cross-platform, OpenGL GPU-accelerated terminal emulator written in Rust.
description: Alacritty is a modern terminal emulator that comes with sensible defaults, but allows for extensive configuration. By integrating with other applications, rather than reimagining their functionality, it delivers blazingly fast GPU-accelerated performance.

capabilities.detail: OpenGL rendering pipeline provides zero latency key typing and fast scrolling.
24-bit TrueColor and font ligature rendering.

name: Wireshark
summary: World’s foremost and widely-used network protocol analyzer and packet capture tool.
description: Wireshark is the world’s foremost network protocol analyzer. It lets you see what’s happening on your network at a microscopic level and is the de facto standard across commercial and non-profit enterprises, government agencies, and educational institutions.

capabilities.detail: Captures live traffic from Ethernet, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, USB, and loopback adapters.
Deep inspection of hundreds of protocols with live color-coded display filters.
Reassembles fragmented TCP streams into plain text or hex data views.

name: DBeaver Community
summary: Free and open source multi-platform universal SQL database tool and data browser.
description: DBeaver Community is a free cross-platform database tool for developers, database administrators, and analysts. Supports all popular relational and NoSQL databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Oracle, DB2, SQL Server, Sybase, MS Access, Teradata, Firebird, Apache Hive, Phoenix, Presto.

capabilities.detail: Syntax highlighting, autocompletion, execution plans, and result export.
Auto-generates Entity-Relationship Diagrams (ERD) from database schemas.
Inline cell editing, sorting, regex filtering, and image/BLOB viewing.

name: Cyberduck
summary: Libre server and cloud storage browser for SFTP, WebDAV, Amazon S3, and OpenStack.
description: Cyberduck is a libre server and cloud storage browser for Mac and Windows with support for FTP, SFTP, WebDAV, Amazon S3, OpenStack Swift, Backblaze B2, Microsoft Azure & OneDrive, Google Drive and Dropbox.

capabilities.detail: Browse, download, upload, and synchronize files across Amazon S3, Azure, and WebDAV.
Seamlessly encrypts directory vaults before sending data to cloud storage.

name: Nextcloud Desktop
summary: Desktop sync client for self-hosted Nextcloud file storage and collaboration platform.
description: The Nextcloud Desktop Client enables you to connect to your private Nextcloud server. Synchronize your files with your local machine, share files with passwords and expiration dates, and access virtual files on demand.

capabilities.detail: Continuous background synchronization with selective sync and conflict resolution.
Windows shell virtual file support to view cloud files without consuming local disk space.

name: ShareX
summary: Screen capture, file sharing and productivity tool with OCR and screen recording.
description: ShareX is a free and open source program that lets you capture or record any area of your screen and share it with a single press of a key. It also allows uploading images, text or other types of files to over 80 supported destinations.

capabilities.detail: Full screen, window, region, scrolling capture, and MP4/GIF screen recording via FFmpeg.
Extract text directly from screen regions using Tesseract OCR.
Draw arrows, blur sensitive information, add text, and drop shadows on screenshots.

name: Flameshot
summary: Powerful yet simple to use screenshot software with in-place annotation.
description: Flameshot is a powerful, open source screenshot tool for Linux, Windows, and macOS. Offers customizable on-screen drawing tools, arrows, text, blur, pin to desktop, and direct Imgur upload.

capabilities.detail: Draw freehand, rectangles, circles, arrows, and highlight text immediately on capture.
Pin captured area as a floating window over the desktop.

name: PeaZip
summary: Free file archiver utility supporting 200+ archive formats with strong encryption.
description: PeaZip is a free file archiver utility, based on open source technologies of 7-Zip, p7zip, FreeARC, PAQ, and PEA projects. Cross-platform, full-featured but user-friendly alternative to WinRAR and WinZip. Supports over 200 archive formats.

capabilities.detail: Extracts 200+ formats: 7Z, ACE, CAB, ISO, RAR, TAR, ZIP, ZIPX, ZSTD.
Secure deletion (shredding), file checksum calculation (CRC32, MD5, SHA), and password manager.

name: Unresolved License Demo Tool
summary: Internal demonstration application with pending or unresolved license determination.
description: This application record exists to test license state segregation. It must never appear when filtering by confirmed_open_source.

capabilities.detail: Used solely for test assertion.

name: Source Available Demo Tool
summary: Application with source-available commercial license, non-qualifying for open source discovery.
description: This application record has non-open-source licensing (SSPL or BSL) to verify that only confirmed open source results qualify.

capabilities.detail: Used solely for test assertion.
